en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.620 – Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:

"Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, made prayer obligatory, and the Messenger of Allah (sw) established it in ten forms: the prayer during travel, the prayer while residing, the prayer of fear in three forms, the prayer during the eclipse of the sun and moon, the prayers of the two Eid’s, the prayer for rain (Salat al-Istisqa), and the funeral prayer."
